description: Scaffold the project and implement the framework-agnostic agent-orchestration engine with a swappable LLM provider boundary and a deterministic mock engine. This is the testable core that drives the IA CEO -> arquiteto -> frontend -> backend -> integrador pipeline. Independent of the React UI (FEAT-002 consumes this).
steps: Create package.json with "type":"module", no dependencies (none are installable), and scripts: "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json", "build": "bun build src/main.tsx --outfile dist/main.js --external \"*\" --target browser", "dev": "bun run dev-server.ts", "test": "bun test", "lint": "eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx", "format": "prettier --write .". NOTE: every command is run by maintainers with NODE_OPTIONS unset.

Create tsconfig.json: target ES2022, module ESNext, moduleResolution "Bundler", jsx "react-jsx", strict true, noEmit true, skipLibCheck true, lib ["ES2022","DOM","DOM.Iterable"], typeRoots ["./src/types","./node_modules/@types"], include ["src"]. Verified working with the react-shim approach.

Create src/types/react-shim.d.ts: hand-written ambient declarations for the React surface the app uses (default React, useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useCallback, FC, ReactNode, Key, FormEvent, ChangeEvent), plus modules "react/jsx-runtime", "react/jsx-dev-runtime" (jsx/jsxs/jsxDEV/Fragment) and "react-dom/client" (createRoot). This lets tsc typecheck .tsx fully offline since @types/react cannot be installed. Also declare a JSX namespace with permissive IntrinsicElements. Add type coverage for all element/event props actually used in FEAT-002 so tsc stays green.

Create src/engine/types.ts: define AgentRoleId union ("ceo","architect","frontend","backend","integrator"), AgentStatus ("idle","working","done","error"), Agent (id, name, roles: AgentRoleId[], status, currentTask, output), Task (id, title, assignedRole, assignedAgentId, status, result), LogEntry (ts, agentId, role, message, level), ProjectArtifact (path, kind, content summary), PipelineState (phase, prompt, tasks, agents, logs, artifacts, startedAt, finishedAt, done). Model roles data-driven so one agent can hold multiple roles.

Create src/engine/providers/LLMProvider.ts: an async interface LLMProvider { name: string; complete(req: { role: AgentRoleId; system: string; prompt: string; context?: unknown }): Promise<string> } and a documented comment block explaining this is the seam where a real OpenAI/Anthropic backend plugs in (not reachable in sandbox).

Create src/engine/providers/MockLLMProvider.ts: a deterministic, offline MockLLMProvider implementing LLMProvider. Given a role + the user prompt, it returns role-appropriate structured text (CEO returns a task breakdown; architect returns a folder/structure + DB schema sketch; frontend returns component list; backend returns API endpoints; integrator returns an assembly + verification report). Deterministic (seedable or pure) so bun tests can assert on output.

Create src/engine/agents.ts: default roster of agents demonstrating multi-role support (e.g., one agent holding both ceo+integrator, others single-role) and a mapping of each AgentRoleId to a human-readable name, description, and system prompt used by the provider. Export factory getDefaultAgents().

Create src/engine/orchestrator.ts: an Orchestrator class/function that takes an LLMProvider and runs the pipeline as an async generator or event-emitting state machine: phase 1 CEO decomposes prompt into tasks per role; phase 2..n each role agent executes its task via provider.complete, updating agent status and emitting LogEntry + ProjectArtifact; final integrator phase assembles artifacts and emits a verification summary. Expose a run(prompt, onEvent) that streams PipelineState snapshots so the UI can render live progress. Keep it deterministic with MockLLMProvider. Include small per-step async delays via an injectable delay fn (default 0 in tests) so the UI can animate without making tests slow.

Create src/engine/orchestrator.test.ts (bun test): assert that run() with MockLLMProvider and delay=0 (a) produces tasks for all five roles, (b) advances every agent to status done, (c) ends with done=true and a non-empty integrator verification artifact, (d) is deterministic across two runs, (e) a reverted/broken orchestrator (e.g., skipping integrator) would fail these assertions. Also add MockLLMProvider.test.ts asserting role-specific content appears for each role.

Create .gitignore (dist/, node_modules/, .DS_Store, *.log, .agents/ optional-leave-in?). Do NOT ignore .agents. Create .prettierrc and .eslintrc.cjs (or eslint.config.js for ESLint 10 flat config) with TypeScript-aware but dependency-free config (ESLint 10 is global; use flat config eslint.config.js with no plugin imports that require install, or minimal rules).
Verify: NODE_OPTIONS= tsc --noEmit passes; NODE_OPTIONS= bun test passes all engine tests.
acceptance_criteria: `NODE_OPTIONS= tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` exits 0 with no errors
`NODE_OPTIONS= bun test` runs and all engine tests pass

orchestrator.run with MockLLMProvider produces tasks for all five roles (ceo, architect, frontend, backend, integrator), moves all agents to done, and ends done=true with a non-empty integrator verification artifact
At least one agent in the default roster holds more than one role (demonstrating the multi-role requirement)
LLMProvider interface and MockLLMProvider are separate files; the provider boundary is documented in comments
findings: Implemented the full offline, framework-agnostic engine and project scaffolding. Files: package.json (type=module, no deps, scripts dev/build/typecheck/lint/format/test), tsconfig.json (ES2022/ESNext/Bundler/react-jsx/strict/noEmit, typeRoots includes ./src/types), src/types/react-shim.d.ts (hand-written React API surface for offline tsc), src/engine/types.ts, src/engine/providers/LLMProvider.ts (documented provider seam) + MockLLMProvider.ts (deterministic, pure), src/engine/agents.ts (data-driven roster; agent 'Ada' holds BOTH ceo+integrator to satisfy the multi-role requirement), src/engine/orchestrator.ts (Orchestrator class with injectable delay fn defaulting to 0 and stepDelayMs, emits cloned PipelineState snapshots via onEvent), plus orchestrator.test.ts and MockLLMProvider.test.ts. .gitignore, .prettierrc, eslint.config.js (flat config). VERIFICATION: 'NODE_OPTIONS= tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json' exits 0; 'NODE_OPTIONS= bun test' => 10 pass / 0 fail. DEVIATIONS/NOTES: (1) Added src/types/bun-test-shim.d.ts ambient declarations for 'bun:test' because @types/bun is not installable (npm blocked) and tsc must typecheck the *.test.ts files offline. (2) ESLint 10 flat config lints only **/*.js, not .ts/.tsx: the built-in parser cannot parse TypeScript and @typescript-eslint/parser is not installable, so TS correctness is delegated to tsc (the 'typecheck' script). The package.json 'lint' script still references .ts,.tsx per the plan for when deps become installable. 'eslint .' and 'prettier --check .' both pass. (3) build script is defined per plan but not runnable yet because src/main.tsx is created in FEAT-002; typecheck+tests are the FEAT-001 gates and both pass. (4) Did NOT commit the .kiro* local config dirs (editor/agent config, not project files); added them to .gitignore. Reminder: all node/bun/tsc/eslint/prettier commands must be prefixed with 'NODE_OPTIONS=' due to the broken preload in this sandbox.
